snapshot.text: Split system of the Ministry of Health (MINSA) and the Social Security Fund (CSS), with frequent medicine shortages. The government is integrating MINSA and CSS services into one system.

priorities.title: MINSA–CSS integration
priorities.text: Merging the ministry and social security health services into one network, backed by President Mulino.

priorities.title: Medicine shortages
priorities.text: A commission on critical shortages of medicines was set up.
